notes.title: Patch is out now!
Patch is out now!
The big update!
The big update!
Release coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're planning to leave Early Access soon with an update which will include 2 new maps and updated user interface. 

At now you can try the new patch:
- New animations on final scoreboard.
- Added your's syndicate cars at the finish waiting for you.
- Added screen notification when you can fully control the bike (when leaving the trailer).
- Removed blocking police cars in Escape game mode (when leaving the trailer).
- In auto steer game modes (1st and 3rd), when you get onto the opposite site of the road you will be teleported on your side of the road.

notes.title: The new patch!
notes.notes:
Hello!

There are patch notes for the update:
- Fixed final camera view for VR
- Fixed respawn algorithm
- Fixed traffic cars lod flickering
- Pistol reloading now reflects on laser
- You can't turn around when crashed
- Even more optimization
